text:
Alex: morning — seeing a ~20% p99 latency spike in hosted-us-west-1 since ~06:12 UTC. error rate holding but tail latency elevated, customers with low-timeout clients are seeing sustained failures. paging in case we need escalation.
OpsBot: ALERT triggered: latency_p99_us-west-1 > 500ms (6m window) — alert_id=ALRT-9642. Pages: primary oncall Alex, secondary Maria.
oncall-bot: note: linked incident created INC-2026-211 (latency spike - us-west-1). Use runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/latency-routing-fallbacks
Maria: on it — shifting to primary. Alex if you want to hand off, I can take lead. Quick check: any customer-facing degradation (500s) or just slow responses?
Alex: mostly slow 200s, ~0.5-1% 504s for short bursts. AcmeCorp reported timeouts on an export job. No widespread 5xx flood.
Jaspreet: logs show a surge of long-context requests hitting the Llama-70-16b quantized variant on pool-gpu-14. KV cache hit ratio dropped by ~12% around spike start. Possible cold-cache + large-batch pattern.
Samir: routing metrics show increased fanout to pool-gpu-14 after autoscaler churned yesterday. We still have a lower spare capacity for long-seq workloads.
Maria: steps — 1) throttle/limit long-seq requests at edge (short-term) 2) route long-seq to warmed pool variant (fallback) 3) warm extra instances / add burst capacity. Who can take which?
Alex: I can push quick throttling rule at the edge for seq_len>2048 to cap concurrency to 4 per client. Give me a minute.
Jaspreet: I'll kick off warm-up for pool-gpu-22 (compatible quant profile) and pre-load KV prefixes for top customers (AcmeCorp, BetaApps).
Samir: I'll examine the autoscaler logs and temporarily increase desired_count for pool-gpu-14 by +2. If anything looks off with the scaler hooks, I’ll revert.
oncall-bot: page assigned: primary Maria, secondary Jaspreet. Reminder: escalate to SRE lead if page not acknowledged in 7m.
Alex: pushed throttling config (edge rule id: ER-7782). Sample rule: 
```
match: request.context_length > 2048
action: limit_concurrency(4)
scope: customer_global
```
Applied to us-west-1; monitoring now.
OpsBot: metric update: p99 latency dropped from 620ms -> 490ms in 90s after rule. KV cache hit slowly recovering.
Maria: good sign. Jaspreet, how long to warm pool-gpu-22? ETA?
Jaspreet: ~6-8 minutes to provision + model load. I'll start pre-warming now. Adding a small routing override to steer ~15% of long-seq traffic to the warmed pool once ready.
Samir: autoscaler increased desired_count on pool-gpu-14 by +2; pods scheduling now. Observed some scheduling waits on AZ-a due to resource contention — moving to AZ-b where capacity exists.
Alex: AcmeCorp support pinged: their export jobs are still failing intermittently. Can we prioritize warming for their tenant prefixes?
Jaspreet: yes — warming prefixes for tenant:acmecorp first. Also enabling soft-fallback routing for their requests to pool-gpu-22 when latency > 400ms.
Maria: quick checklist update:
- Current status: degraded -> partial improvement (p99 ~410-480ms).
- Customer impact: AcmeCorp export jobs intermittent timeouts; <1% other customers seeing increased latency.
- Primary: Maria (taking lead). Secondary: Jaspreet. Escalation: Samir if infrastructure scaling needed.
- Runbook pointers: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/latency-routing-fallbacks and https://redwood-internal/ops/playbooks/prewarm-kv-cache
- Immediate actions taken: edge throttle pushed (Alex), warm pool started (Jaspreet), autoscaler bump (Samir).
Alex: logs snippet for triage (truncated):
```
[06:13:02] req=xyz123 tenant=acmecorp seq=4096 model=llama-70k variant=quant4 load=0.87 latency=612ms kv_hit=false
[06:13:04] req=xyz124 tenant=betaapps seq=512 model=llama-70k latency=210ms kv_hit=true
```
Maria: next steps (assignments):
- Jaspreet: finish warming pool + enable routing override to steer up to 20% long-seq traffic.
- Samir: continue monitoring autoscaler and move workloads across AZs if scheduling delays persist.
- Alex: keep edge rule in place for 15m, then reassess.
- Maria: communicate to Support with current incident note and ETA for warming (15m).
Jaspreet: warming complete, model loaded on pool-gpu-22. I enabled routing override to send 15% of long-seq traffic there.
OpsBot: metric update: after routing change p99 ~390ms and AcmeCorp's export job succeeded on retry. No new increase in 5xx.
Maria: excellent. I'll update INC-2026-211 with the timeline and customer impact. If p99 holds <420ms for 20m and AcmeCorp confirms stable exports, we'll de-escalate and close the incident.
Alex: I'll keep the edge throttle until we confirm steady state then incrementally relax.
Samir: I'll keep watch on autoscaler logs and AZ scheduling for the next hour. If we see re-churn, escalate to infra lead.
Maria: final short-term next steps: 1) 20m monitoring window 2) support note to AcmeCorp + re-run of their export (Samir to coordinate) 3) post-incident: root-cause hypothesis (KV cache cold + autoscaler capacity gap), follow-up action items for preventing recurrence.
Alex: thanks team — handing off to Maria for the monitoring window. Ping here for any regressions. :thumbsup:
Maria: ack — taking primary. Will post closure note when stable.
oncall-bot: thread locked for incident updates only. Remember to file RCA if incident closes with customer impact.
